title: The Glance That Gives Life Back
source_seed: Seed 3: The glance that gives life back (Lalitopakhyana ch. 30, Lalita restores Kama; the compassion-and-glance telling is devotional, secondary)
logline: She lowers her compassionate gaze to the dark water and a rose-gold glow spreads from her look across it, rippling outward.
hook: In the first second her head begins a slow, deliberate dip and her gaze falls to the water in front of the lotus.
story: In the Lalita story, her compassion, shown in a glance, returns life where it was lost. Here the dark water is the lifeless ground; her look lands on it, it warms, and ripples move outward. Then she lifts her eyes to the viewer, as if the gift is passed to them.
loop: Her head returns to the exact front-facing, smiling pose of the first frame, so the end flows into the start.
share_trigger: Sent to someone grieving or worn out: 'she looks at the dark and it lights up'.
caption_hook: She did not say a word. She only looked at the dark water, and it began to glow.
audio: Solemn: a low sustained drone, a single slow bowed tone, then a soft frame-drum pulse (about 90 bpm) entering as the glow spreads, swelling gently at the look-up. No heartbeat. See audio notes in report.

shots.camera: Eye level, front-facing, full-length framing from the reference portrait, held steady, with the tall crown and crescent moon centered and fully framed.
shots.action: Her head dips slowly and Her gaze falls with soft compassion onto the dark water in front of the lotus, and a faint rose-gold glow begins on the water directly under Her gaze. Her hair settles under natural gravity.
shots.purpose: The lowered glance is the action; the warming water is its visible consequence.

shots.camera: The same steady eye-level full-length framing, the crown and crescent moon centered and fully framed.
shots.action: The rose-gold glow spreads outward across the water in slow rings around the lotus, and Her head rises gently back to a front-facing pose, Her eyes meeting the viewer with a deeper, warmer smile. Her hair settles under natural gravity.
shots.purpose: The life She gave spreads, and She offers the gaze to the viewer.
